items.name: Maul
items.description: Mauls are massive warhammers that must be swung with two hands.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Break Legs!
offensiveAbilities.description:
The legbreaker makes a maul Strike against an adjacent creature. If it hits, the creature is knocked Prone and becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 minute. As long as this clumsy condition lasts, the creature also takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speeds and has weakness 5 to the legbreaker's Strikes.

Effect: Break Legs!

offensiveAbilities.name: Rushing Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The legbreaker Strides twice. If they end their movement within melee reach of an enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stampeding Shove
offensiveAbilities.description: The legbreaker Shoves a creature, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to their Athletics check if the target is Prone. If the Shove succeeds, the target takes 2d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage (double damage on a critical success).
